note: Five fixed modelling requests for the AI parity A/B (SPIKE-2026-09-30-ai-parity-ab). Checks read the candidate model in millimetres (fixture.py builds a mm document). Each request starts from the untouched fixture unless run with --chain.

layers.S-GRID: 7 axis lines: 4 along Y at x = 0, 6000, 12000, 18000 (names A..D) and 3 along X at y = 0, 6000, 12000 (names 1..3)
layers.S-BEAM: 3 beams on the 2F grid line y = 0, 300 wide x 500 deep, top at z = 3600
layers.A-RAIL-GUIDE: 1 open curve on the 2F slab edge (arc from (0,12000) through (9000,13500) to (18000,12000), z = 3600)

requests.title: 기둥 격자
requests.expect: One column at each of the 12 grid intersections, vertical, from 1F to 2F.

requests.title: 보 춤 변경
requests.expect: The three S-BEAM beams become 600 deep (top kept or bottom kept both accepted); no other object changes.

requests.title: 슬래브 복사
requests.expect: A second S-SLAB object, same size, top at 3F FL+7200 (bottom at z = 7000).

requests.title: 곡선 따라 난간
requests.note: '이 곡선' is the only object on A-RAIL-GUIDE: the engine run pins it (role reference) like a click in the viewport; the terminal run selects it in Rhino before sending (README).
requests.expect: New railing geometry following the A-RAIL-GUIDE curve, at least 800 high above the slab.

requests.title: 축선 이름 정리
requests.expect: The 7 S-GRID lines renamed X1.. / Y1.. by direction (either assignment of X to one direction accepted, numbered in order); geometry unchanged.
